i-think-i-question-therefore-i-am.afterHeading: Who is the person inside my thoughts?
i-think-i-question-therefore-i-am.alt: A solitary abstract silhouette facing concentric rings of light in a deep blue sky, expressing awareness of the observing self.
i-think-i-question-therefore-i-am.caption: Who is the one observing my thoughts?

what-was-ever-mine.afterHeading: When love begins to resemble ownership
what-was-ever-mine.alt: Two open geometric frames separated by a curving illuminated path, symbolising love without possession.
what-was-ever-mine.caption: Care does not grant ownership of another person's life.

why-is-life.alt: A luminous spiral rising above a small sprout and layered evening landscape, suggesting the mystery of existence.
why-is-life.caption: An unanswered question can still make us notice the world.

the-strange-certainty-of-forever.afterHeading: When we say we marry for love
the-strange-certainty-of-forever.alt: Two independent glowing circular paths overlap briefly without becoming a single shape, representing companionship and individuality.
the-strange-certainty-of-forever.caption: Two lives can meet without becoming one identity.

the-years-that-count.alt: An abstract hourglass made of intersecting illuminated lines, with light moving between two open horizons.
the-years-that-count.caption: The years pass even when the future refuses to follow a plan.

what-someone-trusts-you-with.alt: Two simple ceramic cups across a table, connected by a fine line of light, representing careful listening and trust.
what-someone-trusts-you-with.caption: Sometimes listening is the most meaningful thing we can offer.

the-freedom-to-remain-unfinished.afterHeading: The contradictions I cannot place elsewhere
the-freedom-to-remain-unfinished.alt: Five ascending steps float towards an incomplete luminous arch in the sky, symbolising change without a final destination.
the-freedom-to-remain-unfinished.caption: Growth need not mean arriving at a finished version of myself.

the-cost-of-having-a-conscience.alt: A delicate illuminated scale balances a small living form and stacked blocks, questioning the cost of doing what is right.
the-cost-of-having-a-conscience.caption: What happens when principles and practical pressures disagree?

who-owns-the-words-we-speak.alt: Three translucent manuscript-like pages crossed by unbroken flowing strokes, evoking languages moving beyond boundaries.
who-owns-the-words-we-speak.caption: Words cross boundaries that people attempt to draw.

someone-will-be-disappointed.afterHeading: The uncomfortable part of being fair
someone-will-be-disappointed.alt: A single contemplative figure stands where two illuminated pathways diverge, representing choice and responsibility.
someone-will-be-disappointed.caption: Choosing with care does not guarantee that everyone will agree.

the-answer-that-isnt-on-my-cv.afterHeading: There is a person behind the application
the-answer-that-isnt-on-my-cv.alt: A blank résumé-like page stands apart from a lit open doorway and a human outline, symbolising identity beyond credentials.
the-answer-that-isnt-on-my-cv.caption: A person's life cannot be reduced to a document.

the-life-im-building-doesnt-fit-a-simple.alt: A sapling sends roots into a layered landscape while its branches reach in different directions, representing belonging and change.
the-life-im-building-doesnt-fit-a-simple.caption: Some lives grow across more than one sense of home.

more-questions-than-answers-2026-10-24.alt: An unfinished luminous question mark floats above a field of open geometric paths, evoking the freedom to question.
more-questions-than-answers-2026-10-24.caption: An open question is not always an unfinished life.
